reviews.title: Excellent Aesthetics Option - Same Great Build
reviews.comment:
I returned after realizing I had the correct fan (not reversed) originally.  The reverse blades, however, are very nice (I have two 140mm Reversed Blade Corsair Fans installed).

These fans are very nice.  Well built, great aesthetic appeal, quiet, and move a lot of air.  The "Time Warp" lighting function is very attractive.  iCue software is easy enough to use.  The fans snap together easily with a passive and active connector and feel stable.  The Daisy-chaining solution of the Corsair fans is very clean, but can be tight and limit orientation depending on case size.  The iCue System Hub I found to be an unreliable/sensitive part.  Of the units installed, 4/7 hubs would not work or failed during installations/setup (included with starter packs).

Overall, I am very pleased with Corsair fans.
